props.gloss_en: the mishnah: women, slaves and minors are exempt from the sukkah
the baraita: 'ALL the homeborn' -- to include the minors
the baraita's inclusion speaks of a minor who has reached the age of training; the mishnah's exemption of one who has not
the obligation of a minor who has reached training is rabbinic
[the minor's obligation is] rabbinic, and the verse is a mere support

answered_by.gloss_en: לא קשיא: כאן בקטן שהגיע לחינוך, כאן בקטן שלא הגיע לחינוך (= p_kan_behigia_lechinuch)

objections.gloss_en: קטן שהגיע לחינוך מדרבנן הוא! -- a rabbinic obligation is not derived from a verse

answered_by.gloss_en: מדרבנן, וקרא אסמכתא בעלמא הוא (= p_kra_asmachta_ktanim)
